story_title: Keep the in-progress stop current when a dispatcher reorders the planned stops

scenarios.ac_text: Given a drive order with one stop in progress, when the dispatcher accepts a new order for the planned stops, then the stop in progress is still the current stop.
Given a drive order with one stop in progress, when the dispatcher accepts a new order for the planned stops, then the planned stops follow the dispatcher's order behind the current stop.
Given a drive order with stops already served, when the dispatcher accepts a new order for the planned stops, then the served stops keep their places and are not reordered.

Given a dispatcher who puts the in-progress stop somewhere else in the new order, when they accept that order, then the in-progress stop is still the current stop and the planned stops follow the rest of the order.
Given a driver reading the device at a stop, when the dispatcher's new order is accepted, then the device shows the same current stop and the remaining stops in the new order.
